observation: Push and batch push verify non-empty payload and hash before idempotency, persist tombstone blob atomically and charge quota
counterfactual: Skipping hash verification or bypassing tombstone blob storage causes invalid write rejection and quota assertions to fail

observation: Paged and legacy pull read tombstone blob from disk, return complete ciphertext and enforce exact max_bytes limits
counterfactual: Returning empty ciphertext or ignoring max_bytes bounds causes bounded pull and missing blob fail closed assertions to fail
